## Quality checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] I checked English, Portuguese, and Spanish paths when this changes the site UI.
- [ ] Links point to original providers and do not imply permissions the provider has not granted.
- [ ] New or changed catalog records pass schema validation and use current review dates.
- [ ] I considered keyboard use, reduced motion, and narrow-screen behavior.
- [ ] I did not add generated patches, local exports, credentials, or unrelated files.
